title: Are they lovers or friends? Evaluating LLMs’ Social Reasoning in English and Korean Dialogues

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance in social relationship reasoning across English and Korean dialogue datasets, specifically analyzing failure modes caused by misinterpreting culture-specific features such as honorifics and terms of address.

Qualitative analysis of models' Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning traces to identify instances where they incorrectly reject human-annotated relationships by over-relying on stereotypical relational norms (e.g., assuming parent-child interactions must always be hierarchical or formal) and failing to recognize atypical relationships.
